annotations.text:
Full-page redesign, kept short — what to check

• Hero layout unchanged — the headline is now “An attacker on your side.” / “Un atacante de tu lado.”; the page continues for about two screens: what we test, how an engagement runs, the report (with a sample finding), and a closing CTA. Plain headings, no numbered labels.
• Nothing unverifiable, per your call: no client logos, no certifications, no invented numbers or promises. When you have real proof points we can add them.
• The finding card is fictional and labelled SAMPLE/EJEMPLO — swap in a sanitized real one when you can show it.
• Confirm the four service cards + the small “also on request” line match what you sell.
• The ES/EN link in the header is decorative here; the live site wires it.
• The old single-screen boards are in git history; the earlier long draft is in archive/.
